notes: SHIP v1.14.460 - THE SHIFT WALK: ITS DOOR WAS DEAD, AND NOW IT IS ON COMMAND (owner ruling 2026-08-14). WHAT THE WALK FOUND, and it corrects the record rather than adding to it. PHANTOM_CURRENT_STATE said SHIFT renders today as one pill on Command. It did not render anywhere a technician could see. shift_openSheet had exactly ONE caller in the entire application - an onclick bound onto cc-shiftpill - and that pill measured 0 by 0 and was unreachable at EVERY viewport, 390 and 1440 alike, because it sits inside .lens which sits inside cc-center and both are display none. .lens is the pre-.425 phone composition that the Command Deck replaced; the pill was left behind inside it, and cc- is the retired Crash Cart namespace besides. So shift_renderHero wrote state into a hidden node and succeeded silently on every clock tick - no warning, no toast, and no way for a technician to set a shift end at all. That is the silent-success-into-a-hidden-node class this repo already documents, sitting on a feature the whole shift is named after. THE FIX. The door is cs-shiftbar, a row in the deck's own flow container, filled by shift_renderHero as the single writer and opening the same shift_openSheet. It states the shift honestly - SET SHIFT END when unset, a countdown only once the tech has set one, SHIFT ENDED at zero - and it invents neither a shift number nor a remaining time. A FIRST ATTEMPT AT THIS MOVE LANDED IN A SECOND HIDDEN NODE, which is worth recording because it is the same mistake one layer over. .382 had left a note saying the microbar slot cs-shift was where Phase 2 should re-home the affordance, so that is where it went first - and .cs-microbar is itself display none at 390, hidden by the same phone rule that hides .cs-hd. Present, wired, correct and dead, exactly like the pill it replaced. Spec 40 caught it because it measures GEOMETRY and hit-testing rather than presence: a test asking is the control there and wired would have passed through both defects. The microbar keeps its clock and cmd_clock stays its only writer. TWO THINGS ARE BOTH CALLED SHIFT and the docs now say so. What ships is a shift-END TIMER - 6 AM, 6 PM, plus 12 hours, custom, clear - whose sheet is healthy at 6 controls all clearing 44px. The 9-question SHIFT PILLAR that D-1 argues about is a different and larger concept. Making the timer reachable does not advance the pillar and the pillar's missing data sources do not affect the timer. SITE SLASH SYSTEM PASSED ITS WALK CLEANLY and needed no code: 13 visible controls, zero dead handlers, nothing under 44px, and contents that are purely administrative - profile fields, platforms, save, defaults. The brief's specific suspicion was that operational features might be misplaced there. None are. The walk also confirmed .457 live on that surface: the honesty guard, the evidence rule, the SITE PROFILE block, JOB STATE with the operator, and a token count against the budget. TWO MINOR ITEMS DISCLOSED, NOT FIXED: a Loading storage metrics line that did not resolve during the walk and wants a look on device before it is called a defect; and the CONTEXT INJECTION ACTIVE copy naming three AI surfaces when .457 wired seven - understated rather than false, but now inaccurate on an honesty-adjacent panel. RUNS: spec 40 - 4 passed on phone-webkit. GATES: three-stamp lockstep at .460, inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, brace balance, 0 bare LF, 0 mojibake. DEVICE-VERIFY: open COMMAND. PASS is a SHIFT row visible on the deck reading SET SHIFT END, one tap opening the shift-end sheet, a preset setting a countdown that then shows on the row. FAIL is no row, a row that does nothing, or a countdown appearing before you set one.
